question.short: Are COVID-19 vaccines associated with premature death?
question.long: Do COVID-19 vaccines increase the risk of premature death or all-cause mortality?

description: Results from studies evaluating the impact of COVID-19 vaccines on all-cause mortality and premature death.

no_consensus.description: The literature has not yet reached a consensus on the effects of COVID-19 vaccines on premature death

no.description: The literature suggests that COVID-19 vaccines do not increase the risk of premature death

towards_no.description: The literature suggests that COVID-19 vaccines probably don't increase the risk of premature death, but more research is needed

towards_yes.description: The literature suggests that COVID-19 vaccines may increase the risk of premature death, but more research is needed

yes.description: The literature suggests that COVID-19 vaccines increase the risk of premature death

no.description: The results of the paper show no significant increase in the risk of premature death from COVID-19 vaccines

no_unlike_literature.description: The results of the paper show no significant increase in the risk of premature death from COVID-19 vaccines, unlike what is reported in the literature

no_but_mixed_results.description: The results of the paper show no significant overall increase in the risk of premature death from COVID-19 vaccines, but there are mixed results on specific cases

maybe.description: The results of the paper suggest that COVID-19 vaccines might have an effect on the risk of premature death, but the evidence is not strong enough to conclude

yes_but_low_confidence.description: The results of the paper suggest that COVID-19 vaccines may increase the risk of premature death, but the evidence is not strong

yes_but_small_effect.description: The results of the paper suggest that COVID-19 vaccines may have a small effect on the risk of premature death

yes_unlike_literature.description: The results of the paper suggest that COVID-19 vaccines may increase the risk of premature death, unlike what is reported in the literature

yes.description: The results of the paper suggest that COVID-19 vaccines increase the risk of premature death

papers.title: Association Between COVID-19 Vaccination, SARS-CoV-2 Infection, and Risk of Immune-Mediated Neurological Events: Population Based Cohort and Case-Control Study
papers.quote: Vaccination was associated with a reduced risk of neurological events [...] and death from COVID-19

papers.title: Safety of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine in a Nationwide Setting
papers.quote: Vaccination was most strongly associated with an elevated risk of myocarditis [...] However, the risk of this potentially serious adverse event [...] was substantially increased after SARS-CoV-2 infection and much reduced after vaccination

papers.title: Effectiveness of COVID-19 Vaccines Against SARS-CoV-2 Infection With the Omicron (B.1.1.529) Variant: Second Dose and Booster Dose
papers.quote: Two doses of COVID-19 vaccines remain highly effective against hospitalisation with the Omicron variant [...] Booster doses further increase protection

papers.title: Effectiveness of COVID-19 vaccines against Omicron or Delta symptomatic infection and severe outcomes
papers.quote: Two doses provided moderate-high protection against symptomatic Omicron infection [...] and high protection against severe outcomes

papers.title: COVID-19 Vaccination and Non–COVID-19 Mortality Risk — Seven Integrated Health Care Organizations, United States, December 14, 2020–July 31, 2021
papers.quote: These results showed that vaccinated persons had lower non–COVID-19 mortality risk than did unvaccinated persons. This finding reinforces that COVID-19 vaccines are safe

papers.title: Effectiveness of Covid-19 Vaccines against the B.1.617.2 (Delta) Variant
papers.quote: Only modest differences in vaccine effectiveness were noted with the delta variant as compared with the alpha variant after the receipt of two vaccine doses

papers.title: Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine
papers.quote: A two-dose regimen of BNT162b2 conferred 95% protection against Covid-19 [...] Safety over a median of 2 months was similar to that of other viral vaccines

papers.title: Efficacy and Safety of the mRNA-1273 SARS-CoV-2 Vaccine
papers.quote: The mRNA-1273 vaccine showed 94.1% efficacy at preventing Covid-19 illness, including severe disease. Aside from transient local and systemic reactions, no safety concerns were identified

papers.title: Association of COVID-19 Vaccination With Risk for Incident Diabetes After COVID-19 Infection
papers.quote: COVID-19 vaccination prior to infection was associated with decreased risk of new diabetes diagnosis [...] These findings suggest that vaccination may reduce the risk of long COVID–associated sequelae

papers.title: Effectiveness of BNT162b2 and mRNA-1273 covid-19 vaccines against symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection and severe covid-19 outcomes in Ontario, Canada: test negative design study
papers.quote: The BNT162b2 and mRNA-1273 vaccines were highly effective in preventing symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection and severe covid-19 outcomes in a real world setting

papers.title: Myocarditis after Covid-19 mRNA Vaccination
papers.quote: Myocarditis [...] that occurred in association with Covid-19 mRNA vaccination was mild and resolved quickly in most patients [...] The long-term clinical outcomes remain unknown

papers.title: Risk of Myocarditis After Sequential Doses of COVID-19 Vaccine and SARS-CoV-2 Infection by Age and Sex
papers.quote: In summary, the risk of hospital admission or death from myocarditis is greater following COVID-19 infection than following vaccination [...] and remains modest following sequential doses of mRNA vaccines including the third booster dose

papers.title: COVID-19 vaccine safety in adolescents aged 12–17 years – United States, December 14, 2020–July 16, 2021
papers.quote: The Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System [...] did not detect any new or unexpected patterns of adverse events following COVID-19 vaccination in adolescents

papers.title: Thrombosis with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome Following COVID-19 Vaccination
authors: Celia C. M. M. de Putter
papers.quote: TTS [Thrombosis with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome] is a rare but important complication of vaccination with the adenoviral vector COVID-19 vaccines [...] The risk of TTS needs to be balanced against the very significant morbidity and mortality of COVID-19

papers.title: Myocarditis Cases Reported After mRNA-Based COVID-19 Vaccination in the US From December 2020 to August 2021
papers.quote: Based on passive surveillance reporting in the US, the risk of myocarditis after receiving mRNA-based COVID-19 vaccines was increased across multiple age and sex strata and was highest after the second vaccination dose in adolescent males and young men

papers.title: The Effect of Vaccination on Transmission of SARS-CoV-2: An Observational Study of 100k Vaccinated and Unvaccinated UK Healthcare Workers
papers.quote: Vaccination reduces transmission of SARS-CoV-2, measured both as secondary attack rate and as viral load

papers.title: Association Between mRNA Vaccination and COVID-19 Hospitalization and Disease Severity
papers.quote: Receipt of 2 doses of an mRNA COVID-19 vaccine was associated with reduced risk of COVID-19 hospitalization and in-hospital death

papers.title: Safety and Efficacy of the ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 Vaccine (AZD1222) against SARS-CoV-2: an interim analysis of four randomised controlled trials in Brazil, South Africa, and the UK
papers.quote: ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 has an acceptable safety profile and has been found to be efficacious against symptomatic COVID-19

papers.title: Effectiveness of COVID-19 vaccines over a 9-month period in North Carolina
papers.quote: All three vaccines provided strong and sustained protection against COVID-19-related death

papers.title: Safety of COVID-19 vaccines administered in the EU: Should we be concerned?
papers.quote: While some safety concerns became apparent, the overall safety profile of all COVID-19 vaccines is considered positive, particularly when balanced against the benefits of these vaccines

papers.title: BNT162b2 Vaccine Booster and Mortality Due to Covid-19
papers.quote: Among persons 50 years of age or older, the rate of death from Covid-19 was lower by a factor of 90% among those who had received a booster at least 12 days earlier than among those who had not received a booster

papers.title: Effectiveness of mRNA BNT162b2 COVID-19 vaccine up to 6 months in a large integrated health system in the USA: a retrospective cohort study
papers.quote: BNT162b2 was highly effective against SARS-CoV-2 infections and COVID-19-related hospital admissions and deaths, and modest declines in vaccine effectiveness were observed for infections occurring 4 months after receipt of the second vaccine dose

papers.title: Effectiveness of COVID-19 vaccines in preventing SARS-CoV-2 infection among frontline workers before and during B.1.617.2 (Delta) variant predominance — Eight U.S. Locations, December 2020–August 2021
papers.quote: COVID-19 vaccines remain highly effective in reducing risk for infection, hospitalization, and death, even against the B.1.617.2 (Delta) variant

papers.title: Comparative Effectiveness of Moderna, Pfizer-BioNTech, and Janssen (Johnson & Johnson) Vaccines in Preventing COVID-19 Hospitalizations Among Adults Without Immunocompromising Conditions
papers.quote: All 3 vaccines were highly effective in preventing COVID-19 hospitalization in a U.S. population without immunocompromising conditions

papers.title: Effectiveness and durability of a second COVID-19 booster against severe outcomes among older adults in Israel
papers.quote: A second booster dose reduces the risk of COVID-19-related death by 78% and hospitalization by 64% among older adults

papers.title: Association Between 3 Doses of mRNA COVID-19 Vaccine and Symptomatic Infection Caused by the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron and Delta Variants
papers.quote: Receipt of 3 doses of an mRNA COVID-19 vaccine was associated with protection against both Delta and Omicron variants, but with lower effectiveness against Omicron

papers.title: Risk of Myopericarditis following COVID-19 mRNA vaccination in a large integrated health system: A comparison of completeness and timeliness of two methods
papers.quote: The risk of myopericarditis following mRNA COVID-19 vaccination is low and the outcomes are favorable [...] However, the benefits of COVID-19 vaccination clearly outweigh the risks

papers.title: Effectiveness of Covid-19 Vaccination Against Risk of Symptomatic Infection, Hospitalization, and Death Up to 9 Months: A Swedish Total-Population Cohort Study
papers.quote: Vaccine effectiveness against death due to COVID-19 remained high up to 9 months after full vaccination in the total population

papers.title: Effectiveness of Covid-19 Vaccination Against Risk of Symptomatic Infection, Hospitalization, and Death Up to 9 Months
papers.quote: BNT162b2-induced protection against infection waned progressively over 6 months, whereas protection against hospitalization and death persisted, with a modest decline at 4 months or longer after receipt of the second dose

papers.title: Effectiveness of COVID-19 vaccines against hospitalisation in adolescents in England: a test-negative case-control study
papers.quote: COVID-19 vaccines were highly effective at preventing COVID-19-associated hospitalisation among adolescents
